# GENERATED by `npx ray gen` from implementation/physics.ray - do not edit
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(orbitmines-physics VERSION 0.0.1 DESCRIPTION "OrbitMines: Physics Project" LANGUAGES CXX)

include(GNUInstallDirs)

if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR AND NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE AND NOT CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
endif()

file(GLOB ORBITMINES_PHYSICS_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.cpp)
add_library(orbitmines_physics ${ORBITMINES_PHYSICS_SOURCES})
add_library(orbitmines::physics ALIAS orbitmines_physics)
set_target_properties(orbitmines_physics PROPERTIES EXPORT_NAME physics OUTPUT_NAME orbitmines-physics)
target_compile_features(orbitmines_physics PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
target_include_directories(orbitmines_physics PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include> $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}>)
target_compile_definitions(orbitmines_physics PRIVATE
  ORBITMINES_PHYSICS_THEOREMS_INSTALLED="${CMAKE_INSTALL_FULL_DATADIR}/orbitmines-physics/theorems.json"
  ORBITMINES_PHYSICS_THEOREMS_SOURCE="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/share/orbitmines-physics/theorems.json")
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(orbitmines_physics PRIVATE /bigobj /utf-8)
endif()

install(TARGETS orbitmines_physics EXPORT orbitmines-physics-targets
  ARCHIVE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR} LIBRARY DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR} RUNTIME DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR})
install(DIRECTORY include/ DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR})
install(FILES share/orbitmines-physics/theorems.json DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/orbitmines-physics)
install(EXPORT orbitmines-physics-targets NAMESPACE orbitmines:: FILE orbitmines-physics-config.cmake DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/orbitmines-physics)
